title: Sonic 3D: Flickies' Island
overview: The world's most famous video-hero makes his debut in the 32bit world of Sega Saturn! 7 massive zones of textured landscapes and awesome 3D bonus levels set the scene for Sonic's greatest clash with Dr. Robotnik. Blistering sound effects, full-motion cartoons and Sega's legendary gameplay come together to rocket Sonic into the 21st Century!
